claim.quote: The measured muon flux is f = (6.33 +/- 0.04_stat +/- 0.35_sys) x 10^{-8} [s^{-1} cm^{-2}].

key_value_text.quote: We report the first measurement of the underground cosmic muon flux at the Stawell Underground Physics Laboratory.
key_value_text.value: We report the first measurement of the underground cosmic muon flux at the Stawell Underground Physics Laboratory.

name: Measurement of the cosmic muon flux at the Stawell Underground Physics Laboratory

summary.plain: The first measurement of the cosmic-ray muon flux in the Stawell Underground Physics Laboratory, made with the muon-veto panels of SABRE South: about 6.3 muons per 100 million seconds per square centimetre.
summary.technical: Eight EJ200 plastic-scintillator panels with Hamamatsu R13089 PMT pairs (the SABRE South muon veto, data taken in 2024-2025): f = (6.33 +- 0.04 stat +- 0.35 sys) x 10^-8 cm^-2 s^-1, in excellent agreement with simulations.

title: Measurement of the cosmic muon flux at the Stawell Underground Physics Laboratory
why_it_matters: It is the first published data from the SABRE South installation and the first underground muon measurement at SUPL.
